prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Pasadena, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1198; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the parking lot collision you reported in Pasadena, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident, if that's alright.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was backing out of a space near the entrance of the shopping center. It was pretty busy, with carts and people walking between the cars.

Q: What happened as you were backing out?

A: I checked my mirror, saw nothing coming, and started reversing slowly. Then I felt a bump on the driver's side rear. The other car had come up the lane faster than I expected.

Q: How fast would you estimate the other vehicle was moving?

A: Not fast, maybe walking speed or a little quicker. It wasn't a big hit, but it jolted me forward and back.

Q: Did you stop your vehicle immediately after the impact?

A: Yes, I put it in park right away and got out to look at the damage.

Q: Have you sought medical attention since the collision?

A: I went to urgent care the same afternoon. My neck was stiff and I had pain running into my shoulders. They said it looked like whiplash and gave me a neck brace and some medication.

Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms?

A: Yes. Turning my head to the right is hard, and I get headaches toward the end of the day. I've had to take time off from my physical activities.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything you'd like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I'd just like to get my car repaired and get back to normal.

Q: Thank you for your cooperation. This concludes the recorded statement.
